title: Amazon Haul’s early Haul-iday deals event: $1 flash deals, $0.11 steals, and millions of items under $10
summary: From November 9–14, customers can score ultra-low prices across fashion, beauty, home, electronics, and more from Amazon Haul.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Amazon Haul’s early Haul-iday deals event runs November 9–14, featuring $1 flash deals all week and exclusive $0.11 deals on November 10–11.


- Customers can shop more than 10 million products across fashion, beauty, home, electronics, holiday decor, and more, with the majority of items priced under $10 and more than a million under $5.


- Deal drops will continue throughout November and December across holiday categories like stocking stuffers, holiday decor, and seasonal apparel.


- Orders of $25 or more qualify for free delivery, with 5% off orders over $50 and 10% off orders over $75.


---


Looking to get a head start on holiday shopping without stretching your budget?


[Amazon Haul](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-haul-ultra-low-prices-under-10) is kicking off the season with early Haul-iday deals from November 9–14, featuring $1 flash deals dropping all week and exclusive $0.11 deals on November 10 and 11.


[When is Black Friday 2026? Here’s everything you need to know](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/when-is-amazon-black-friday-faq)


Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. Here’s what to expect, how to prepare, and how to save.


In two years, Amazon Haul’s selection has expanded by more than 25 times to more than 10 million products—from fashion and beauty to home, electronics, toys, holiday decor, and more—with the number of customers making purchases growing nearly 350% year over year.


The majority of items are priced under $10, including more than a million under $5 and more than half a million under $3.


This deal event is on top of the ultra-low prices Amazon Haul offers customers every day and is the first in a series of deal moments running through November and December, with new daily and weekly drops across holiday favorites.


“We've always focused on offering customers the lowest prices across the widest selection, and Amazon Haul is another way we‘re making holiday shopping more affordable,” said David Forsythe, vice president of North America Seller Business. “Whether customers are decorating their homes, dressing the family for festivities, hosting a holiday gathering, or filling up stockings, there’s so much to discover on Amazon Haul, with millions of products at ultra-low prices and new deals dropping all season long.”


## What deals can customers find on Amazon Haul this holiday season?


The early Haul-iday event features some of the lowest prices Amazon Haul has ever offered—and it’s just the start. Here's what to expect:


- $1 flash deals dropping throughout the week across fashion, beauty, home, electronics, toys, and more


- $0.11 deals on November 10–11—exclusive hidden treasures across popular categories


Plus, come back for a daily and weekly refresh of deals across holiday favorites:


- Stocking stuffers


- Holiday decor


- Seasonal apparel and accessories


- White elephant gifts


- Beauty essentials


- And millions of items under $10, with some as low as a penny during flash sales


Haul is just another way Amazon works to make


[everyday life more affordable](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-affordable-everyday-savings) . Customers are filling their carts with a mix of everyday essentials and trending finds—from viral beauty products and fashion staples to practical kitchen accessories and home organization must-haves. And with daily deal drops, flash deals, and curated collections, there's always something new to discover.


Looking for inspiration? Start with these popular holiday and everyday finds:


- [3D Pop-Up Holiday Card](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKWD26V9)
- [8-Pack Santa Ornaments](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HDTH39WP)
- [Holiday Window Suncatcher](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FH9XN9ML)
- [Santa Sleigh Pop-Up Card](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBJYC6C7)
- [Golden Playing Cards](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G4M8KRZD)
- [6-Pack Magnetic Hooks](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H6B36GXV)
- [42-Piece Sewing Kit](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DSVHJ23Q)


[Amazon’s 2026 Top 100+ Toys list: Something for every kid at heart](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/best-gifts-kids-amazon-toys-we-love-list-2026)


From budget-friendly finds and Amazon exclusives to trending collectibles, sensory toys, and screen-free favorites, the annual list for 2026 spotlights 100+ expert-curated toys to make holiday gifting easier.


## How does Amazon Haul help customers save even more?


Beyond ultra-low prices, Amazon Haul rewards customers who build up a bigger cart:


- Free delivery on orders of $25 or more


- 5% off orders over $50


- 10% off orders over $75


Haul also makes it easier than ever to discover deals. Relevant Amazon Haul products now surface within Amazon search results when they’re a great match for what you’re looking for, and every customer's Haul feed gets more personalized the more they browse, adapting from the homepage all the way through to checkout.


For customers who love watching products in action before they buy, Amazon Haul’s expanded integration with


[Amazon Live features](https://www.amazon.com/live) more creators and more frequent livestreams across fashion, beauty, home, tech, and more—with real-time reviews and the ability to shop directly from the stream.


Amazon Haul makes shopping fun, easy, and affordable, all through the Amazon shopping experience customers know, love, and trust. Customers can shop with confidence knowing that the products they're purchasing are safe, authentic, and in the condition expected.


## How to shop Amazon Haul


Customers can find Amazon Haul in the Amazon Shopping app by searching “Haul” in the search bar, navigating from the main menu icon, or by visiting the


[Amazon Haul page](https://www.amazon.com/haul) .


For any item a customer chooses not to keep, Amazon Haul offers free returns on all eligible purchases over $3 within 15 days of delivery, with convenient drop-off at


[more than 10,000 locations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/operations/free-returns-with-no-box-tape-or-label-needed) across the U.S., including Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, UPS, Kohl's, and Staples. All items are covered by Amazon’s A-to-z Guarantee.


Shop Amazon Haul’s early Haul-iday deals from November 9–14, or visit the


[Amazon Haul page](https://www.amazon.com/haul) to start browsing now.
